description: Use when the user wants to see ticket options and fee-inclusive prices for a specific XP event after `search_events` (e.g. 'cheap seats', 'parking for the game'). Pulls the live offer book of resale inventory. Do not use before an event has been resolved — call `search_events` or `get_event_details` first. Prices are dollars: each ticket row carries per_ticket_usd. error_code NO_INVENTORY means the event is real but has nothing listed right now: do not retry, give the user the event page or another date.

event_id.description: Event identifier from search_events or get_event_details. If omitted, the assistant should search/select an event first.

is_ga.description: If true, filter for general admission only.

max_cache_level.description: Backend cache level override (advanced; usually omit).

max_price_usd.description: Maximum all-in price per ticket in dollars.

min_price_usd.description: Minimum all-in price per ticket in dollars.

parking_only.description: If true, return only parking tickets.

section_ids.description: Section IDs filter (list, comma-separated string, or numeric IDs; supports simple ranges like '100-110').

name: get_ticket_listings
title: Get Ticket Listings
